statement: Pinned SDL Xbox 360 HIDAPI excludes Microsoft wireless receiver IDs and wireless interface protocol 129. On Linux, SDL's evdev backend discovers joystick-capable input nodes, assigns a new SDL joystick instance ID at each addition and removes it when its devnode disappears. An xpad wireless slot therefore follows Linux evdev add/remove semantics rather than being opened as a wired SDL HIDAPI Xbox 360 device.
